metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.8 · 1975 · White Collar Blues
metas.description: A good-natured but unlucky Italian is constantly getting into difficult situations, but never loses his positive mood.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.7 · 1976 · Fantozzi 2
metas.description: The frustrating adventures of a humble employee who spends all of his time fulfilling his bosses' wishes and desires.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.1 · 1980 · Fantozzi Against the Wind
metas.description: The accountant Ugo Fantozzi is a born loser: for him the problems of the office and everyday life becomes huge catastrophes.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.4 · 1983 · Fantozzi Succumbs Again
metas.description: After a hard day at work and a condominium-board meeting, accountant Ugo Fantozzi goes on a trip with his family. Unfortunately, he will face a nasty surprise upon his return.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.4 · 1986 · Super Fantozzi
metas.description: Fantozzi, an unlucky character, traces his ill-fated lineage from being expelled from Eden through various humiliating adventures across time periods until reaching the future Space Age.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.2 · 1988 · Fantozzi Retires
metas.description: After 30 years in the big corporation, Ugo Fantozzi retires. Suddenly he needs things to do in everyday life and he tries a number of activities: helping Pina with her shopping, babysitting granddaughter Uga, traveling to Venice, ...

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.8 · 1990 · Fantozzi alla riscossa
metas.description: New misadventures of Accountant Fantozzi, including managing his nephew Ughina's film career and being juror in a Mafia trial.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.6 · 1993 · Fantozzi in Heaven

metas.name: 9 · ★ 5.3 · 1996 · Fantozzi - Il ritorno

metas.name: 10 · ★ 4.5 · 1999 · Fantozzi 2000 - La clonazione
metas.description: Ugo Fantozzi was resurrected from the company where he worked because of a crisis. How it will end?
